messages:
mike_ops: @jordan_vendor quick sync — PO# 8942 allocations landed and we're seeing a capacity spike in NA next month. Can you confirm whether you can reroute 8 units from your EU pool to CA warehouse to help cover Q3 demand? Also we have 3 DOA units from the last pallet that need RMA handling. TL;DR: reroute feasibility, ETA, cross‑border handling cost, and pricing for a 20‑unit buffer (committed) with ~6 week lead

jordan_vendor: Hey Mike — thanks. We can reserve 8 units out of the EU manifest but cross‑region transfer requires export docs + import brokerage. Handling is typically 6% of unit value + customs duties (varies). Leadtime for transfers: 4–7 weeks depending on sloting. For a committed 20‑unit buffer we can offer tiered pricing, see below. I can also initiate RMA process for the 3 DOAs now.

ellie_procure: can you send the line‑item pricing with the tiers? 6% handling seems high if we're moving in bulk. Need unit landed cost to compare vs short‑term cloud rental. Also what's the SLA/credit if transfer slips?

jordan_vendor: Pricing (USD/unit):
```
list price: 2400
5–19 units: 2280 (5% discount)
20–49 units: 2160 (10% discount)
50+ units: 1990 (17% discount)
handling fee for cross‑region transfer: 6% of unit FOB (waivable for committed orders > 30 units)
optional expedite: +8% (2–3 day air gap)
SLA credit: 3% monthly credit if vendor misses agreed ETA by >7 days
```

sasha_sre: Important context — our autoscaler will exhaust spare capacity by day 10 of next month if we don't get ~8 physical GPUs in region. Short‑term cloud uplift cost is ~12k/week for equivalent capacity. If vendor can guarantee <=5 week arrival we take the transfer. Otherwise we'll mix: 4 units transfer + 4 short‑term cloud rentals. Also the DOAs: replacement vs repair? We need replacements to avoid spin up windows.

nina_logistics: For RMAs, we need serials + photos of failure and original AWB. If replacements are issued we can consolidate replacement AWBs onto a single export to save customs time — reduces chance of partial holds. Consolidation note: one consolidated AWB requires aligned SKUs and same consignee. Insurance: standard shipment insurance covers DOA up to invoice value unless we flag latent defect.

mike_ops: Serial list for DOAs (from last pallet, pallet 7):
```
SN: RW-FF12-000341
SN: RW-FF12-000342
SN: RW-FF12-000343
AWB: EU1234567890
manifest: pallet7_manifest_v3.pdf (on shared drive)
```

rma-bot: RMA request submitted to vendor portal (ticket 2026‑RMA‑778). Vendor has 48h to acknowledge. RMA IDs: RMA‑778‑A, RMA‑778‑B, RMA‑778‑C. Tracking will be attached once vendor confirms pickup.

jordan_vendor: Acknowledged RMA 2026‑RMA‑778. We can do replacements (same model) and will aim to consolidate shipments. For the 8 units: we can do a split plan — 4 units on the next weekly pallet (ETA ~ 28 days) and 4 units via dedicated transfer manifest (ETA ~ 35 days). Expedited air for all 8 would be ~5 days but at +8% per unit and customs brokerage pre‑clear fee. If Redwood commits to the 20‑unit buffer at the 10% discount (2160/unit) we can waive the 6% handling fee for the transfer. SLA credit can be negotiated to 4% if you want stronger penalties.

ellie_procure: Counterproposal: commit to 20 units at 10% discount (2160/unit) if vendor: 1) waives handling fee for the 8‑unit transfer, 2) provides ETA guarantee (<=35 days for full 8 units) with a 2.5% SLA credit for misses, and 3) includes insured consolidated AWB for the replacements at no extra cost. Agree?

jordan_vendor: We can accept 1 + 3. For 2) ETA guarantee we need a signed LOA for customs brokerage and priority sloting; then we can lock <=35 days. The SLA credit we can do 3% firm, or 2.5% if you prepay 30% deposit on the buffer order.

sasha_sre: Deposit asks are fine from infra POV if it protects timeline. Can procurement confirm payment terms quickly? Also please push manifest updates to eng‑infra channel when available so we can plan node staging.

nina_logistics: If you accept vendor terms I'll prepare consolidated AWB draft and insurance addendum. Note: consolidated AWB will require us to list a single consignee — that'll be Redwood CA ops. Customs broker needs power of attorney (POA) copy.

mike_ops: @ellie_procure can you confirm we can do 30% deposit by EOD? If yes I'll mark 8 units as high priority in the cluster plan. Also Jordan, please start RMA replacement pick‑up for the 3 DOAs immediately.

ellie_procure: Will confirm payment by EOD pending final PO. Leaning yes — I want the waived handling fee in writing. Please add that to the PO terms: "handling fee waived for cross‑region transfer as part of 20‑unit buffer commitment."

jordan_vendor: Will include that clause in the PO and send updated commercial terms by 12:00 PST. Initiating replacement pickup for RMA‑778 now. :thumbsup:

sasha_sre: Great — thanks. If anything slips pls @sasha_sre and @mike_ops. We'll prepare temporary cloud uplift plan in case first tranche slips.

nina_logistics: I'll draft AWB consolidation and insurance paper and upload to the shared drive under `logistics/2026/q1/vendor_transfers/`. Will ping when done.

mike_ops: Thanks everyone — moving to action items. :white_check_mark:
